title: The running backend rewrites two TRACKED files under data/ on every Sleeper poll, so a deployed checkout's git tree is never clean
claimUnderTest: .gitignore:45 is a bare `data/`, and CLAUDE.md describes data/ as "MOSTLY gitignored" runtime output — implying the running app's writes land on untracked paths.
observed: `git ls-files` shows data/sleeper_last_good.json and data/scrape_state/sleeper_last_success are TRACKED, and `git check-ignore` matches neither (tracked files ignore .gitignore). The audit harness booted the backend read-only, with run_scraper monkeypatched to a no-op and no scrape ever executed, and both files still changed: sleeper_last_success moved 1785867508.5162156 -> 1785914134.965936 and sleeper_last_good.json's savedAt advanced with a full re-serialization of all 12 rosters (~340 KB of diff). The writes come from the ordinary Sleeper-overlay refresh on the request path, not from scraping. Observed three times across the session; restored by hand each time.

reproduction.command: cd /home/user/riskittogetthebrisket && git ls-files data/sleeper_last_good.json data/scrape_state/sleeper_last_success && git status --porcelain data/
reproduction.expected: Runtime state written by the app lands on gitignored paths; `git status` stays clean while the server runs.
reproduction.actual: Both paths are tracked; `git status --porcelain data/` reports both modified after the backend has been up long enough to refresh the Sleeper overlay.

numericProof.formula: count(tracked files modified by the running process with no scrape executed)

userImpact: Not user-facing. It is deployment-facing: a production checkout's working tree is dirty within minutes of boot, so `git pull --ff-only` on the deploy host fails or silently stashes, and any deploy script gating on a clean tree either blocks or learns to ignore real drift. It also means every deploy can carry one league's cached roster snapshot into the repository as a committed diff.

priorFinding.note: Adjacent to W03-F010 (a READ path rewriting the shared canonical rank snapshot) — same class, different files. Neither W03-F010 nor the .gitignore findings (W05-F012, W15-F011) cover these two paths. Found by the orchestrator while restoring drift between repair waves, not by a workstream.

whatWorks: The write itself is correct behaviour — caching the last-good Sleeper payload is what lets the app degrade honestly when Sleeper is unreachable, and W31 is not an argument against that cache.
rootCause: These two files were committed before `data/` was gitignored. A tracked file ignores .gitignore, so the bare `data/` rule that was meant to keep runtime output out of the repo does not apply to them, and nothing since has noticed.
requiredRepair: `git rm --cached` both paths so the runtime writes land on ignored files, and confirm nothing reads them from the repository rather than from the deployed filesystem (a fresh clone must still boot — `load_from_disk` already tolerates their absence, and tests/e2e/preflight.py seeds what the stack needs). Then check `git ls-files data/` for the same pattern elsewhere: 8,198 files under data/ are tracked, and any of them the app writes at runtime has this defect.
